name: auditor-executor-protocol
description: The Auditor/Executor protocol for multi-phase work with agents, as a skill, plus the aeprogress pane that follows a run. The Auditor writes numbered tasks with gates and audits each delivery by re-running it; Executors implement one task at a time and log their evidence. The pane (/aeprogress) shows progress per phase and who works on what, holds back Executor launches when the machine is busy, and compacts the Auditor's session when a phase closes. The pane needs a run made with the protocol and the aepkit CLI (pipx install aepkit); it does nothing on its own.

runDir.title: Run folder
runDir.description: The folder holding compliance-log.md, relative to the workspace or absolute. Empty: the newest compliance-log.md found up to three levels under the working directory. /aeprogress <folder> overrides it for the session.

externalWorkers.title: External workers
externalWorkers.description: Where to look for workers outside this session. auto: Orca when the session runs inside an Orca terminal, or the workers file when one is set. orca: always ask Orca. file: only the workers file. off: only this session's subagents and the status board.

workersFile.title: Workers file
workersFile.description: For any other harness: a text file it keeps with the workers running now, one per line, relative to the run folder or absolute. Every line that names a task ID such as P1-T3 shows that task as in progress, with the rest of the line as who. The mod only reads it.

autoOpen.title: Open at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts in a workspace that has a run. Off: only /aeprogress opens it.

launchLimit.title: Launch limit
launchLimit.description: While a run is found, refuse launching an Executor (a Claude Code subagent whose prompt names a task of the run, or an Orca worker-start) past the limits below, with a message saying why. Off: the pane only watches.

maxWorkers.title: Most live workers
maxWorkers.description: Live Executors (subagents and Orca workers together) above which no other is launched.

maxBuilds.title: Most building workers
maxBuilds.description: Live Executors that build at once. A handoff with the line "Load: docs-only" does not count as building.

maxBusyPercent.title: Busiest machine for a build (%)
maxBusyPercent.description: No building Executor is launched while the machine is busier than this: Unix load over cores, or Windows CPU %.

spotlightTip.title: Spotlight recommendation (macOS)
spotlightTip.description: When Spotlight's indexing stays busy, recommend excluding the project folder in System Settings > Spotlight > Search Privacy. It only recommends; it never changes a setting.

spotlightCpuPercent.title: Spotlight CPU that triggers the recommendation (%)
spotlightCpuPercent.description: Indexing CPU, added up over Spotlight's processes, held on two reads in a row.

compactOnClose.title: Compact on phase close
compactOnClose.description: Give the Auditor a tool that, when a phase closes, compacts the session after a countdown and resumes the Auditor with its own message. The owner can cancel, compact at once, type a prompt, or compact by hand. Off: the tool is not offered.

compactCountdownSeconds.title: Compaction countdown (seconds)
compactCountdownSeconds.description: How long the band waits, after the Auditor's turn ends, before compacting.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: compare this copy with the marketplace catalog Claude Code keeps on disk, and say in the pane when a newer version is listed. It makes no network request; the catalog is refreshed by Claude Code (turn on auto-update for this marketplace). off: no check. Copies installed from the claude.ai directory update themselves and are never checked.
